blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), through its RLove program and The Gift of Change (TGOC), a coin bank collection campaign, recently turned over a donation of five (5) units of printer and eighty (80) units of ink to Ilaya Barangka Integrated School in Mandaluyong City.

L-R: Cookie Marquez, RLC Corporate PR Manager; Mike Torres, RLC Corporate Social Responsibility Manager; Adrian Hernandez, Assistant to the Principal, Secondary Department Ilaya Barangka Integrated School; and Helena Vibar, Assistant to the Principal, Elementary Department Ilaya Barangka Integrated School

With Department of Education’s Brigada Eskwela, RLC was tapped to help in preparing the school for the opening of classes. This significant donation will benefit over 3,000 students of Ilaya Barangka Integrated School and this is just one of the supports of RLove and TGOC in continually upholding the delivery of quality education amidst COVID-19 crisis wherein regular face to face classes are not yet allowed. Since most of the learners are enrolled under modular distance learning, this equipment will boost the reproduction of learning materials prepared by the teachers and non-teaching personnel of the school.
